Hey there gate crew,
Our lead trainer sent an update on quiet areas and wants us to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk briefing consistent across the counter and the phone line. Keep the tone calm, keep the steps simple, and steer passengers toward the quiet area guidance before they reach the gate. If someone seems unsure, walk them through the paperwork in plain language and keep the focus on what they need to do next.

For cabin checks and pet handoff prep, stay alert for crate fit issues and flag anything that looks off before boarding starts. <<FACT F068>> Make sure travelers understand that our role is to reduce confusion, not add to it, so keep the explanation short, steady, and polite. If a passenger comes in with a pet and extra concerns, note the issue clearly and hand it to the senior coordinator without delay.

Keep an eye on tone at the counter and in email replies, especially when the line is busy and people are already stressed. We do better when we stay brisk, accurate, and warm enough to keep things moving without sounding rushed. Pass along any repeat concerns so we can tighten the guidance for the next shift and keep the handoff clean for Aurelia Skyways passengers.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
